description_en: Creates an inference job to generate images based on a personalized text-to-image model
description_zh: 个性化文生图/基于一个模型创建图片推理任务
name: Personalizedtxt2imgAddInferenceJob

parameters.help_en: The model ID to use for the inference job
parameters.help_zh: 模型训练任务id, 指定要用哪个模型进行推理
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.help_en: An English prompt describing the image to generate. Replace the subject with . For example, change "a man in the snow" to "a in the snow", and "a photo of a girl" to "a photo of a "
parameters.help_zh: 英文prompt描述生成的图像, 要生成的角色用<special-token>替代, 如“a man in the snow”要改为"a <special-token> in the snow", "a photo of a girl"改为"a photo of a <special-token>"
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.help_en: The number of images to generate. Note: Due to resource limits in the test environment, you can generate up to 10 images per request. The system automatically sets values greater than 10 to 10
parameters.help_zh: 要生成图片的数量。注意: 由于测试环境资源限制，一次最多生成10张图片, 该值大于10按10处理
parameters.name: image_number

parameters.help_en: The seed for the random number generator. Using the same seed ensures reproducible results. The value must be between -1 and 2,147,483,647. If the value is outside this range or is not specified, the system automatically generates a suitable seed
parameters.help_zh: 随机数种子，该种子固定时可以得到相同的生成图像，确保结果的可复现性，注意: 输入值需处于[-1, 2147483647]，输入值在该区间外或者不输入时将自动生成一个合适的种子
parameters.name: seed
